newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy '96 maize harvest seen at 9.2 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Italy '96 maize harvest seen at 9.2 mln tonnes.

text.p: Preliminary estimates put Italy's maize output at some 9.2 million tonnes in 1996, up from 8.47 million last year, the Italian Institute for Agriculture Studies said in a note on Friday.
The area rose to 992,900 hectares from 941,400 in 1995, Ismea said.
Production is expected to increase by 12.1 percent in the northeast and by 6.1 percent in the northwest. "Central Italy's harvest should drop 0.4 percent because of lower sowings," Ismea said.
It put average yields up 2.9 percent at 9.27 tonnes per hectare, with a peak around 9.4-9.6.
Heavy rains in northern and central Italy, where most of the maize is produced, have delayed the harvest.
Italy's maize producers association said no precise estimates were available on how much maize had already been collected, and no one at Ismea was available for comment.
